title: CoreS3-UserDemo #4: camera page releases the shared internal I2C bus and never restores it; symptom not reproduced on virtual CoreS3

execution.environment: macOS; local Device Service with QEMU cores3 backend (esp-emulator 55e5763e); PlatformIO toolchain not installed

checks.name: bus_restored_after_camera_deinit
checks.evidence: AppCamera.cpp:50-56 only calls esp_camera_deinit(); no M5.In_I2C.begin()/Wire1.begin() exists in src/

checks.name: touch_is_the_only_lvgl_input_path
checks.evidence: lib/m5gfx_lvgl/m5gfx_lvgl.cpp:21-47 reads M5.Display.getTouchRaw() (FT6336 on the same GPIO12/11 bus)

checks.name: display_continues_without_i2c
checks.evidence: display flush is SPI via M5.Display; no I2C dependency in m5gfx_lvgl_flush()

checks.name: virtual_repro_exit_camera_then_tap
checks.evidence: two Camera->Home cycles on QEMU cores3 with the V0.5 image; IMU and WiFi pages still opened afterwards, so the symptom was not reproduced (see evidence/05,06)

checks.name: hardware_repro
checks.evidence: no physical CoreS3 available for touch interaction

checks.name: build_main_and_flash
checks.evidence: PlatformIO not installed in this environment

evidence.description: camera page with live GC0308 preview and ALS bars
HomeMenu redrawn after leaving the camera app
IMU page opened by touch after leaving the camera app (not reproduced)
second camera enter/exit cycle, then WiFi page opened by touch
ROM boot log only; application logs go to USBSerial and are not routed to the console
frame hashes, firmware hash, code locations and environment facts

notes: The code-level finding is a candidate mechanism, not a confirmed root cause; hardware confirmation is required.
The virtual pass shows the page-manager and event paths are not the cause in that environment.
Duplicate esp_camera_fb_return() in AppCamera is idempotent with esp32-camera v2.0.0 cam_give() and is not the reported cause.
No internal endpoints, credentials, or device identifiers are included.
